issues: After loading sample CSV and committing, React logs duplicate key warning 'Encountered two children with the same key, students-1778503074420' repeatedly. The 3 sample rows are likely assigned ids using a single Date.now() snapshot or hard-coded ids that collide if commit is invoked more than once or coexist with seeded ids. Fix: in BulkImport.jsx, generate per-row unique ids (e.g. `students-${Date.now()}-${i}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`) before demoStore.add.

rca of the issue: Only one minor non-blocking React console warning detected: BulkImport sample rows share a key 'students-1778503074420'. RCA: ids are generated once when sample is loaded and then reused; reproducing → /dashboard/bulk-import → click 'or load sample data' → click 'Commit X rows' → React DevTools shows duplicate-key warnings as those rows are added to demoStore that may already contain an entry with the same fabricated id. Mitigation: change BulkImport.jsx parseCSV/loadSample to attach `id: \`stu-${Date.now()}-${index}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}\`` per row. No functional impact – import still succeeds and toast shows.
